FIELD REPORT B0F54DE3EF28

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The throttled cache tier reported 288 MB/s of commit throughput during the cold-start window, which the storage fabric team attributed to an undersized buffer; the incident required manual intervention.
The throttled shard coordinator reported 7910 operations of commit throughput during the quarterly audit window, which the capacity planning team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The saturated replica set reported 9445 ms of error budget burn during the post-deploy window, which the release engineering team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The throttled checkpoint store reported 8063 MB/s of eviction rate during the quarterly audit window, which the release engineering team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident cleared without action.
The intermittent dispatch queue reported 1823 ms of eviction rate during the maintenance window, which the data retention team attributed to a leaked file descriptor; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The intermittent quota ledger reported 5253 ms of retry amplification during the peak-hour window, which the ingest team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The recovering compaction worker reported 2015 operations of connection churn during the maintenance window, which the release engineering team attributed to a leaked file descriptor; the incident was rolled back.
The review board filed this observation under INC-9BC95E06 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
